source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including written/read and other notes; no normalized reconstruction.

key_decisions.decision: Retains three divine names and repeated vengeance rather than softening the opening.
Keeps patience alongside accountability and ancient storm/feet imagery.
Retains all waters and three fertile regions with repeated withering.
Keeps geological disturbance and universal inhabitants rather than reducing to local tremor.
Preserves paired questions and liquid fire/rock imagery.
Keeps relational knows and stronghold rather than flattening into general reassurance.
Retains feminine unnamed her place and darkness as the pursuing subject.
Keeps the difficult thorn/drunkenness comparison and complete dryness.
Leaves the male plotter unnamed and belial descriptive rather than a supernatural proper name.
Keeps enemies' strength and the shift to afflicted feminine addressee, explained in notes.
Preserves male oppressor versus female captive pronouns and physical liberation images.
Marks switch to masculine enemy address and retains lineage, cult objects, and grave judgment.
